title: A well-shuffled deck is almost surely in an order never seen before
body: A 52-card deck can be ordered in 52! ways, meaning 52 × 51 × 50 × … × 1, which comes to about 8 followed by 67 zeros. Even if every human who ever lived had shuffled a deck every second since the Big Bang, they would have produced only a vanishingly tiny fraction of those orders. Mathematicians have shown that about seven good riffle shuffles are enough to mix a deck thoroughly, after which its exact sequence is almost certainly brand new.

slides.question: The number of ways to order a 52-card deck is 8 followed by how many zeros?
slides.explanation: About 8 followed by 67 zeros. Even if every human who ever lived had shuffled a deck every second since the Big Bang, only a vanishing fraction of those orders would have appeared.

slides.heading: Ways to order a hand of cards, to scale
slides.note: Every extra card multiplies the count. A full deck of 52: about 8 followed by 67 zeros.

slides.clue: The operation written 52!, multiplying every whole number from 52 down to 1
slides.detail: 52! is about 8 followed by 67 zeros, so a well-shuffled deck is almost surely in a brand-new order.
